result.summary: This PR replaces the hand-maintained bitcoin-cli bash completion script with one autogenerated from the getopenrpcinfo RPC's OpenRPC output, and adds a functional test (tool_rpc_autocompletion.py) that regenerates and diffs the file, with an --overwrite mode to refresh it. It also wires positional and -named argument completion, including file/dir/boolean value suggestions inferred from parameter descriptions.
result.problem: The existing bitcoin-cli.bash completion file must be manually updated whenever RPC commands change, and it drifts out of sync; contributors and users of bash completion get stale or missing suggestions. Multiple past attempts (#18606, #25243, #30860) tried to fix this but were never merged.

open_concerns: Author's own description flags: enumerated values (e.g. sighashtype) are not yet supported since getopenrpcinfo doesn't expose enums; commands are a superset when bitcoind is compiled with features (e.g. wallet) disabled, which could suggest commands that don't work.
No reviewer has weighed in yet on the generation approach or the large generated file.

result.card: This PR autogenerates the bitcoin-cli bash completion script from the new getopenrpcinfo RPC output and adds a functional test that keeps it in sync, closing long-standing issue #17289 after three earlier unmerged attempts (#18606, #25243, #30860).
